items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: They was able to pay more money. ... Every time he get somebody that's getting into the spotlight, they attract him, Fletcher Henderson or Duke, often

ctx.x: Can you talk a little about the music? I mean --

He used to have the best guys arranging for him. He used to go -- sometime he didn't have no money to pay his room because he had to pay the arrangement. He used to buy arrangements, the best arrangements for all kind of money, money he don't make himself.

But that was his idea. I want the best band. I want the best arrangements. I've got to go to the top, and (inaudible) but I'm going to be there. I've got to get there. He was right too, because every time he developed somebody, they take them away -- Fletcher and Duke and all that (inaudible). They was able to pay more money.
